title: SW_PRIMITIVE_OPEN_QUESTION_ROADMAP
the_question_verbatim: What is an SW dynamically, and what native propagation law turns SW contact, echoes, pairs, and physical interaction into resolved 3D ledger events?
primitive_commitments: SW is the smallest thing that exists
A=1 makes measurable traversal distance diverge in the parent chart
A=1 parent boundary maps to an A0-like 2D seed condition in the boundary lane
universe and black holes are closed spheres
working_translation: SW is the minimum contact/write quantum
A is accumulated SW displacement density
The substrate carries echoes along a 2D boundary support
3D reality appears where echoes physically interact and ledger-resolve
Stable particle-like modes are paired standing echoes

candidate_equation.operator_form: L_SW[u_H] = d^2_t u_H - c_SW^2 * Delta_H u_H + K(A_H) u_H + R_res[u_H]
candidate_equation.reading: propagation + tension response + resolution loss = source + paired recoil
candidate_equation.violin_string_analogy: the standing-echo dynamics of SW on a 2D boundary support behave like a tensioned violin string with dissipative resolution

downstream_partial_answer_chain.contribution: operator form on closed 2D support; discrete standing modes; omega_l^2 = c_SW^2*l(l+1) + K0
stability selector PAIR_CLOSED_STANDING_ECHO; Delta A_source + Delta A_recoil = 0
P_i = |E_i|^2 / sum |E|^2 -> I_phys threshold -> X_c ownership -> W_SAM
R_res[E,C,W] = -Pi_C(E) on completed write; Pi_C(E) = C*<C,E>/<C,C>
K_AB(a,b) = -cos(a-b) from antipaired boundary contact modes
G = [[0,-1],[1,0]]; u'' + u = 0; recovers mode equation, antipaired recoil, K_AB, I_phys, threshold, R_res in one fixture
compact dimensionless phase cycle; finite positive stress skeleton; K0 = 1; A_H = A0 * N_SW; eta/hbar magnitude remains external
